title: MAST: Mask-Guided Attention Control for Training-Free Regional-Multi Style Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2604.12281v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Style transfer applies the appearance of a reference image to a content image while preserving its spatial structure. Recent diffusion-based methods achieve strong stylization but typically assume a single global style. We instead consider regional-multi style transfer, which assigns multiple references to user-specified regions of a content image. Extending them to this setting reveals two coupled shared-attention issues: ambiguous mass allocation among content and style partitions and degraded selectivity as more styles are jointly normalized, while style aggregation at the attention output further suppresses fine details. We propose MAST (Mask-Guided Attention Control for Training-Free Regional-Multi Style Transfer), a unified attention-control framework for frozen diffusion models. translated_title: MAST：用于免训练区域多风格迁移的掩码引导注意力控制
translated_abstract: 风格迁移是将参考图像的外观应用于内容图像，同时保留其空间结构。近期基于扩散模型的方法实现了强大的风格化效果，但通常假设单一的全局风格。我们转而研究区域多风格迁移，即将多个参考图像分配给内容图像中用户指定的区域。将现有方法扩展到这一设定时，会暴露出两个相互耦合的共享注意力问题：内容与风格分区之间的注意力质量分配模糊，以及随着更多风格被联合归一化而导致的选择性退化，同时注意力输出处的风格聚合进一步抑制了细节。我们提出了MAST（掩码引导的免训练区域多风格迁移注意力控制），这是一个面向冻结扩散模型的统一注意力控制框架。其中，Logit级注意力质量分配强制执行由掩码导出的分区质量，锐度感知温度缩放自适应地恢复选择性……
tldr: 提出MAST框架，通过掩码引导的注意力控制，在冻结扩散模型上免训练地实现区域多风格迁移，解决了共享注意力中的质量分配模糊与选择性退化问题。
en_tdlr: MAST is a training-free, mask-guided attention control framework that enables regional multi-style transfer in frozen diffusion models by resolving attention mass allocation ambiguity and selectivity degradation in shared attention.
